import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.DataFrame({
    'amount': [115.02, 44.37, 144.25, 536.22, 38.43],
    'is_fraud': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'transaction_type': ['refund', 'payment', 'transfer', 'payment', 'payment'],
    'hour_of_day': [22, 5, 21, 17, 5]
})

# Create a violin plot to visualize the distribution of transaction amounts by type
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.violinplot(x='transaction_type', y='amount', data=data, inner='quartile')

# Set plot labels and title
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Amount')
plt.title('Distribution of Transaction Amounts by Type')

# Save the plot as output.png
plt.savefig('output.png')
